user.title: Add a Presence Sensor
user.description: Select your Matter sensor. Enter the two lines of the private code on its display as one 26-character code with no spaces. Save a private copy for reconnection.

reconfigure.title: Reconnect the Presence Sensor
reconfigure.description: Enter the private calibration code you saved during setup. If you replaced the code, enter the new one.
